description: This Swift source file provides testing support utilities for WebSocket interactions used in GatewayWebSocket tests within the project. It includes extensions for handling WebSocket ping messages, functions to generate and parse WebSocket message payloads, and mock implementations of WebSocket tasks and sessions for unit testing.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of a WebSocket task for testing purposes, supporting sending and receiving messages with hooks for customization and simulating WebSocket behavior.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that manages the creation and tracking of GatewayTestWebSocketTask instances for testing WebSocket interactions.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Keeps unit-test doubles resilient to protocol additions by implementing a no-op ping handler.

methods.name: connectChallengeData
methods.description: Generates a Data object containing a JSON-encoded challenge message with a nonce.

methods.name: connectRequestID
methods.description: Parses a WebSocket message to extract the request ID if it is a connect request.

methods.name: connectOkData
methods.description: Generates a Data object containing a JSON-encoded response indicating a successful connection acknowledgment.

methods.name: connectAuthFailureData
methods.description: Creates a Data object with a JSON payload representing an authentication failure response with optional details.

methods.name: requestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message, if it is a request.

methods.name: requestFrameObject
methods.description: Parses a WebSocket message into a JSON dictionary.

methods.name: okResponseData
methods.description: Generates a Data object containing a JSON response indicating a successful response to a request.

methods.name: snapshotCancelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times cancel has been called on the WebSocket task.

methods.name: snapshotConnectRequestID
methods.description: Returns the current connect request ID stored in the web socket task.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Transitions the WebSocket task to a running state.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the WebSocket connection with a specified close code and reason.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket message asynchronously, invoking optional hook for testing.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives a WebSocket message asynchronously, using hook if provided or defaults to pre-defined messages.

methods.name: emitReceiveSuccess
methods.description: Simulates a successful reception of a message by invoking the pending receive handler.

methods.name: emitReceiveFailure
methods.description: Simulates a failure in receiving a message by invoking the pending receive handler with an error.

methods.name: snapshotMakeCount
methods.description: Returns how many times a WebSocket task has been created.

methods.name: snapshotCancelCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of cancellations across all tasks.

methods.name: latestTask
methods.description: Returns the most recently created mock WebSocket task.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a new mock WebSocket task for testing.
